field_changes.new:
Added Canyon Aeroad CFR CANYON//SRAM
Improved Android graphics and texture quality, improving the clarity of kits, accessories, bikes, and terrain.
Fixed an issue that could cause settings sliders to not be draggable on touch screen devices.
Added achievement badges and XP available for runners on six routes.
Fixed an issue that could cause Power Bests shown in the post-ride Progress Report to be inconsistent.
Improved the accuracy of estimated route completion times for climbing routes.
